To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) DDoS attacks are more dangerous in SDN environment than the conventional networks; (ii) the DDoS detection and prevention mechanisms are not well studied in SDN; (iii) SDN controller and OpenFlow switch are the most vulnerable parts of the SDN architecture; (iv) the DDoSTree is a novel approach that could be used for identifying DDoS attack features in SDN; and (v) SDN controller is a single point of failure

, DDoS attacks can be categorized in three types: (1) DDoS attacks which can be detected by the SDN controllers, (2) DDoS attack which can't be detected by the controllers, and (3) DDoS that can be detected by SDN controllers and switches.
DDoS attacks could be launched in SDN by exploiting vulnerabilities in SDN controller, OpenFlow switches and OpenFlow protocol.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying the features that could be used for DDoS detection in SDN environment.
identifying DDoS detection feature in SDN environment and to provide a better understanding of DDoS attack behavior in SDN.
the identification of various DDoS attack possibilities and features for detection of DDoS in SDN.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DDoS attacks could be detected in SDN environment if the features like traffic flow, packet header, packet payload, port numbers, source and destination IP address, and protocol are considered.
DDoS attacks are not a threat to SDN but they are a threat to the SDN controller.
DDoS attacks are possible in SDN environment and it could be detected with the help of features such as traffic volume, flow rate, and packet rate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified various types of DDoS threats in SDN environment.
the SDN is more susceptible to DDoS attacks and hence the detection features of DDoS should be implemented at the controller level.

the SDN architecture is more vulnerable to attacks such as TCP SYN Flood, UDP Flood, DNS Flood, and ICMP Flood as compared to others and the features like flow table size, bandwidth, packet rate and packet size could help in identifying these attacks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, SDN architecture can be made more robust to DDoS attacks if it's designed with proper DDoS detection mechanism.
, DDoS attack detection features could be identified by analyzing the behavior of DDoSe attacks on SDN architecture.
the SDN controller is most susceptible to DDoS attacks.
